description: Open-source vector illustration rebuilt in pure Rust: pen and booleans, live blends and effects, gradient mesh, perspective grids and image tracing
notes: VectorCraft's data directory (settings, autosave, logs) is redirected to '$persist_dir\config' through the VECTORCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, so it lives in Scoop's persist store and survives 'scoop update'.
VECTORCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR is a USER-level environment variable, so any other VectorCraft installation (the MSI build, for example) uses this directory too.

The first install copies an existing %APPDATA%\VectorCraft into the persist folder. 'scoop uninstall' removes the variable and VectorCraft falls back to %APPDATA%\VectorCraft, so the pre-uninstall hook mirrors the state back there first; that also runs on 'scoop update'.
The portable zip does not register the file associations that the MSI installer adds.
The app has no built-in updater; use 'scoop update vectorcraft' so the install and this manifest stay in sync.
pre_install: abort 'VectorCraft is running, so %APPDATA%\VectorCraft cannot be copied into Scoop persist safely. Quit VectorCraft, then run the install again.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while copying '$legacy' to '$target'; compare the two directories before relying on the new location." } else { info "Copied '$legacy' to '$target'." }
pre_uninstall: warn 'VectorCraft is running, so the state was not mirrored back to %APPDATA%\VectorCraft. Quit it and uninstall again if you want that safety copy.'

if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while mirroring '$data' back to '$legacy'." } else { info "Mirrored '$data' back to '$legacy': scoop removes VECTORCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR on uninstall and VectorCraft falls back to that path." }
